payload.claim: The mechanism needed to implement 'Cross into the stack base's batch' (resolving a stack_layers row's predecessor_key across a batch boundary into the predecessor task's branch/spec_id, and asking whether that task is itself a layer) is not spelled out anywhere in the Context section. The Context names only four Ledger methods (stack_batch_of, stack_layers, record_key, tasks_by_repo) and only hints, via 'tasks_by_repo carries task_id and spec_id but no key', that the cell must build its own record_key -> (task_id, spec_id) map by pairing tasks_by_repo with per-row record_key calls. The one place this exact problem is already solved in this codebase (saffron/finish.py:531-547, saffron/cli.py:2883-2891) instead reaches directly into the private ledger._db.execute(...), a pattern the spec never surfaces or sanctions. A cell could plausibly copy either technique, and the spec gives no steer on which is intended, even though one quietly breaches Ledger's own abstraction boundary in new code the spec doesn't call out.
